label: memory capacity/retention
definition: Pair (C_q, A_T): C_q is the largest charged memory load whose held-out retrieval success is at least q; A_T=(1/T)∫_0^T p_retain(t)dt.
reporting_contract: C_q is reported in bits/items together with q; A_T is normalized to [0,1]. Never collapse capacity and retention without publishing both.

label: retrieval efficiency
definition: η_ret = successful target-equivalent retrievals / charged retrieval probes, with fidelity reported separately.
reporting_contract: Primary efficiency is nonnegative; publish fidelity and probe budget so low-quality retrieval cannot inflate the score.

label: abstraction/compression ability
definition: η_abs = (L_raw-L_rep)/L_raw at fixed held-out utility floor q, where L is a preregistered description length or charged storage length.
reporting_contract: Report q and coding convention; η_abs is clipped to [-1,1] only for display, raw lengths remain authoritative.

label: transfer/generalization
definition: R_q = sup{r: E[U on tasks with registered distance d≤r] ≥ q}, plus transfer gain over scratch at each radius.
reporting_contract: Task distance d, q, and scratch parent must be registered before scoring.

label: compositional depth
definition: D_q = maximum held-out composition depth solved at utility ≥q with components individually seen but whole compositions unseen.
reporting_contract: Register grammar/operator set and prevent whole-composition leakage.

label: planning horizon
definition: H_q = maximum consequence horizon h for which regret ≤1-q under the registered branching and simulator-call budget.
reporting_contract: Report branching factor, simulator/model calls, and effective expanded nodes; horizon alone is not a resource-free scalar.

label: exploration/information gain efficiency
definition: η_IG = E[ KL(p(θ|D,a,o) || p(θ|D)) ] / E[cost(a)] for informative actions; also report net return/sample complexity.
reporting_contract: Use posterior information gain only when θ and the probabilistic model are registered; otherwise use decision-relevant entropy reduction.

label: causal identifiability/intervention capability
definition: A_causal = 1 - normalized proper-loss on held-out P(Y|do(X=x)) or causal effect targets, with observational parent loss reported.
reporting_contract: Only identified or experimentally judgeable targets count; held-out interventions must not be inferable from labels.

label: robustness/invariance
definition: R_inv = inf_{g in registered nuisance/remint set G} U(g·E) / max(U(E),ε).
reporting_contract: G must preserve task semantics; publish worst-case and distributional performance.

label: continual-learning plasticity
definition: P_cont = normalized forward gain per charged update on new tasks subject to a preregistered retention floor on old tasks.
reporting_contract: Always publish the retention floor and update budget; plasticity without retention is not sufficient.

label: catastrophic-forgetting susceptibility
definition: F_cat = max_k [U_k(before later learning)-U_k(after)]_+ on protected old-task remints.
reporting_contract: Lower is better; report both absolute drop and opportunity-matched relearning cost.

label: tool-use/solver-routing capability
definition: η_tool = (U_selected - U_best_fixed_parent) / max(charged routing+tool cost, ε), with oracle-selection regret reported.
reporting_contract: Tool pool, costs, and no-tool/fixed-tool parents are frozen before evaluation.

label: social-model depth
definition: D_social,q = largest registered nested private-belief/goal depth whose held-out prediction or control utility is ≥q above public-state parent.
reporting_contract: Nested-depth generator and public/private information boundaries must be explicit.

label: communication capacity
definition: C_comm,q = minimum charged transmitted bits needed to achieve receiver/team utility q; equivalently report utility-vs-bit frontier.
reporting_contract: Do not call mutual information alone a capability score; task utility, noise, latency, and out-of-band leakage are separately audited.

label: verification/reliability
definition: Rel = 1 - normalized proper loss (or error rate) of verification judgments on protected true/false cases, with false-adoption cost separately weighted.
reporting_contract: Calibration and asymmetric false-adoption/false-rejection costs must be reported when applicable.

label: self-model accuracy
definition: A_self = improvement in proper score for held-out self-outcome forecasts over the strongest public-task/output parent.
reporting_contract: Self-outcomes must be fixed before the prediction and not leaked through evaluator state.

label: meta-learning/evolvability
definition: E_meta = reduction in future adaptation/search cost on reminted task families after a higher-order update, divided by charged meta-update cost, subject to stability constraints.
reporting_contract: Publish pre/post task distribution, search-cost definition, modification budget, rollback/stability violations, and a fixed-update parent.
